610:t_2:60.en:
$$ランド$$
「His presence is like a typhoon that throws everything into chaos.」

610:t_2:61.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I knew you could be harmed too. But...」

610:t_2:62.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's not say any more about it.」

610:t_2:64.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know how $$アサキム$$'s presence will affect things...」

610:t_2:65.en:
$$ランド$$
「But I feel we need to settle things with him too... settle them in the truest sense.」

610:t_2:66.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You're as positive as ever.」

610:t_2:68.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「And you're just as overbearing as ever.」

610:t_2:70.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm glad to see you're well, $$マルグリット$$.」

610:t_2:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, it was bad luck for you to get worked to the bone by the Chief.」

610:t_2:73.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「My $$パールネイル$$ is also the culmination of $$インサラウム$$'s dimensional science.」

610:t_2:74.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sure His Late Highness would approve of using its power to assist the doctor's research.」

610:t_2:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yes. Maybe I'm just imagining it, but I think so too.」

610:t_2:76.en:
$$クロウ$$
「By the way, $$マルグリット$$... When we parted during the $$再世戦争$$, you said there was something you wanted to tell me when we next met...」

610:t_2:78.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「It... wouldn't be fair right now...」

610:t_2:80.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. This isn't the time for that.」

610:t_2:82.en:
$$トライア$$
「I know... I'll let you see $$エスター$$.」

610:t_2:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is she aboard this ship too?」

610:t_2:89.en:
$n
「...To think you transferred the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ here during the battle...」

610:t_2:90.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This $$ソーラリアン$$ was designed to operate the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ system and transport it to where it is needed.」

610:t_2:91.en:
$n
「Did you leave $c to finish this ship?」

610:t_2:92.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize for keeping so much secret. But we could not allow the Empire to discover the $$ソーラリアン$$'s existence.」

610:t_2:93.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This ship and the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ will be our trump cards in the fight against $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_2:95.en:
$n
「Did you ask Miss $$スズネ$$ to leave just so you could show me this?」

610:t_2:96.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I cannot say it is entirely unrelated.」

610:t_2:97.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Above all, you would not want Miss $$スズネ$$ to hear what we are about to discuss either, $n.」

610:t_2:99.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In the battle at $$インダストリアル７$$... you used the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$... of the $$スフィア$$s, didn't you?」

610:t_2:101.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$... It forms the core of the twelve $$スフィア$$s.」

610:t_2:103.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to the information I have, the $$スフィア$$s were originally one entity, which was divided into twelve for some reason.」

610:t_2:104.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Each $$スフィア$$ governs a human emotion. Among them, the $$いがみ合う双子$$ has the role of integrating and controlling their power.」

610:t_2:105.en:
$n
「Why does it have that kind of power...?」

610:t_2:107.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I believe $$サイデリアル$$ knows this too, and that is why they have treated you as special, $n.」

610:t_2:108.en:
$n
「They intend to use me for their own purposes...」

610:t_2:109.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $n... Even if all twelve $$スフィア$$s come together, you must never try to use that power.」

610:t_2:111.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In Miss $$スズネ$$'s case, I believe the power activated because the holders of all twelve $$スフィア$$s rejected her death.」

610:t_2:112.en:
$n
「$$クロウ$$ and the others would, sure, but did the Empire's Reactors and even $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ reject her death too?」

610:t_2:113.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is my conjecture, but they probably rejected the person who caused her death, rather than Miss $$スズネ$$'s death itself.」

610:t_2:115.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That miracle occurred because the wills of all the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s aligned for an instant.」

610:t_2:116.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if a single human attempts that sort of control over events, only tragedy awaits.」

610:t_2:118.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You would probably cease to be able to exist as a human.」

610:t_2:120.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please look inside the case holding this $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

610:t_2:123.en:
$$トライア$$
「...That girl is $$エスター$$.」

610:t_2:125.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$エスター$$... How on earth did this happen...?」

610:t_2:126.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「$$ヴァイオレイション$$... It is an aftereffect of becoming a $$次元獣$$.」

610:t_2:128.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The $$スフィア$$ powers of $$クロウ$$ and Prince $$ユーサー$$ restored her humanity, but the effects of the 《$$リヴァイヴ・セル$$》 remained...」

610:t_2:129.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At present, $$エスター$$ is something like a miniature $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

610:t_2:131.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$ has fused completely with her biological functions. It controls $$次元力|lc$$ much as a body converts food to energy to function.」

610:t_2:132.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Having become a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, $$エスター$$ can absorb the surrounding $$次元力|lc$$ and control it through her own will.」

610:t_2:133.en:
$$トライア$$
「But since the $$新世時空震動$$, the amount of $$次元力|lc$$ Earth draws out has risen beyond anything seen during the $$再世戦争$$.」

610:t_2:134.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Had she continued absorbing it unconsciously, $$エスター$$'s body and mind would have collapsed completely.」

610:t_2:135.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$エスター$$ is now in suspended animation to protect herself from that torrent of $$次元力|lc$$.」

610:t_2:136.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I understand why she's in a coma. Then why is she here, in a place like this?」

610:t_2:138.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. $$エスター$$ acts as the converter that controls the $$次元力|lc$$ drawn out by the $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

610:t_2:140.en:
$$トライア$$
「You can call me a monster, a devil...」

610:t_2:141.en:
$$トライア$$
「At first, I was continuing my research to save $$エスター$$. Then I thought of using her to solve the problem of controlling $$次元力|lc$$, where I'd hit a dead end...」

610:t_2:142.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...You're still continuing the research to save $$エスター$$, aren't you?」
